method: Evidence hierarchy: (1) dated operator documentation, (2) contemporaneous RIR records, (3) contemporaneous PeeringDB or equivalent archived records, (4) contemporaneous RouteViews/RIS observations, (5) reputable dated technical documentation. Current metadata was used as a research lead only, never as historical proof. Origin identity and path predicate are separate questions; no ASN was inferred from an organization name alone.
path_predicate_note: MAN LAN is an Internet2-operated exchange. The candidate externally-visible path predicate for routing through the MAN LAN / Internet2 relationship is ContainsAny[11537] (Internet2 transit presence; AS11537 holder INTERNET2-RESEARCH-EDU confirmed via RIPEStat 2026-08-01). This is a CANDIDATE predicate: it requires empirical validation against contemporaneous 2019-08-21 RouteViews observations (Stage A preflight) before any run. It is kept separate from each target's origin mapping.

sources.note: Wayback capture 2019-08-26: NORDUnet, Primary ASN 2603, Network Type Educational/Research, IRR as-set AS-NORDUNET, present at NYIIX (198.32.160.21); record last updated 2018-10-10

targets.reviewed_statement: NORDUnet operated AS2603 in August 2019 with high confidence (2019-dated PeeringDB capture + registry record unchanged). Routed backbone operator, not Layer-2-only.
